requirements.quote: Proposals with functionality/technical points of less than the pre-determined minimum overall percentage of 100% on any of the individual criteria will be eliminated from further evaluation.
requirements.text: Proposals must meet 100% of individual criteria to avoid elimination.

requirements.quote: It is critical for all the components of the Device mentioned above to function in order to meet our minimum requirements.
requirements.text: All device components must function to meet minimum requirements.

requirements.quote: Refer to Annexure A for the scoring sheet that will be used to evaluate functionality.
requirements.text: Refer to Annexure A for the functionality scoring sheet.

requirements.quote: Proposals will be eliminated under the following conditions:
requirements.text: Proposals will be eliminated if they meet certain conditions.
Proposals submitted after the deadline will be eliminated.

requirements.quote: Proposals submitted at the incorrect email address
requirements.text: Proposals sent to the wrong email address will be eliminated.
Suppliers restricted by National Treasury will be eliminated.

requirements.quote: Failure to submit fully completed and signed SBD 4 and SBD 1.
requirements.text: Failure to submit completed and signed SBD 4 and SBD 1 will result in elimination.

requirements.quote: Non-attendance of the compulsory briefing session
requirements.text: Not attending the compulsory briefing session will result in elimination.
